text:
mia.partnerships: Heads-up  planning voucher-driven SI onboarding pilot tied to HW partner co-marketing. Goals: fast-track 20 SI cert attempts in 4 weeks, capture deploy metrics, and coordinate announcement sequencing. Need owners: voucher flow, sandbox ops, cert rubric, marketing timing.

oscar.enablement: I'll own the cert rubric + mentor playbook. Proposal: three badges (Access, Verified Lab, Live Demo). Voucher redeems to one hosted sandbox + one proctored attempt. Offline redemption allowed if partner requires air-gapped. I'll draft flow.

tara.si-ops: From SI perspective: need redemption codes scoped per partner, redemption API, and a simple status webhook so we can show progress in our portal. Also request a Marketplace metadata template for the lab exercise.

hugo.hw-partner: HW team funds 30 vouchers. Marketing asks to delay any public co-announcement until at least 12 completions, but ok with partner case studies on a 1:1 basis before public release. We prefer hosted sandboxes so telemetry is available.

luke.ops: Ops constraints: hosted sandboxes are 48h provision, Dedicated pool reservations required. If vouchers go live before CAP ticket we'll get overloaded. Please wait for CAP-13456 before issuing bulk codes.

amanda.training: I have an offline facilitator ZIP (slides, labs, proctor checklist) ready. Proctor model: recorded demo + 15m live Q&A. Pass criteria: 70% checklist + successful end-to-end deploy. I'll add remediation guidance.

mia.partnerships: Ownership recap: Oscar -> rubric + playbook; Tara -> redemption API spec + portal hooks; Luke -> CAP ticket for sandbox capacity; Amanda -> offline kit + proctor SOP; Hugo -> confirm marketing threshold in email. I'll sync with legal re recordings.

tara.si-ops: Redemption API sketch: { code: "HW-XXXX", partner: "hugo-hw", type: "hosted|offline", user_email: "si@company.com" } Webhook event: voucher.redeemed -> voucher.status (claimed|used) -> deploy.completed.

hugo.hw-partner: Confirming marketing threshold: will email Mia with a note that public press requires 12 certs. Internal OK to share early case studies.

luke.ops: Filing CAP-13456 to reserve 25 sandboxes and mark maintenance windows. ETA 36h. Will tag this thread.

amanda.training: Will add voucher redemption step to the facilitator guide and include an "offline kit checklist" for air-gapped installs. Also adding a short consent script for recordings.

ioscar.enablement: I'll publish the initial playbook draft to the partner repo by Thu COB and include badge mapping and the 10-question multiple choice for Verified Lab. Link will follow.

infra-bot: Reminder  Dedicated maintenance Sun 03:00 UTC may affect provisioning.

mia.partnerships: Thanks. Quick timeline: Luke files CAP today, Oscar posts playbook Thu, Tara shares API spec tomorrow, Hugo sends marketing confirmation. If all on track we'll open voucher issuance the following Monday limited to 20 codes to start. Any objections?

tara.si-ops: No objections. I'll prepare a short webhook receiver sample for the SI portal and post it here.

oscar.enablement: Sounds good. Also adding a short Marketplace metadata snippet for the lab: ```yaml
listing:
  title: "SI integration demo"
  description: "Private deploy + fallback demo for partner validation"
  contact: "si-support@example.com"
```

mia.partnerships: Great  ping me once CAP ticket is created so I can coordinate legal and partner comms. Thanks everyone!
